title: Transformations of Functions: Shifts, Reflections, and Stretches
seo_title: Transformations of Functions Worksheet: Shifts, Reflections, Stretches (Algebra 2) | 100 Questions
standard_text: Identify the effect on the graph of replacing f(x) by f(x) + k, k f(x), f(kx), and f(x + k) for specific values of k (both positive and negative); find the value of k given the graphs. Recognize even and odd functions from their graphs and algebraic expressions for them.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 2 worksheet on transformations of functions: shifts, reflections, stretches, moving points, matching graphs and even and odd functions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: g(x) = a·f(x − h) + k: h moves left/right (opposite sign), k moves up/down.
key_sub: A negative a reflects over the x-axis; |a| > 1 stretches the graph.
body_html:
How it works

For g(x) = a · f(x − h) + k:

  • h shifts the graph horizontally, the opposite of the sign you see: f(x − 3) moves right 3.
  • k shifts it vertically: + up, − down.
  • a stretches it vertically (|a| > 1) or shrinks it (0 < |a| < 1). A negative a reflects it over the x-axis.
  • f(−x) reflects over the y-axis.

A function is even if f(−x) = f(x) (symmetric about the y-axis) and odd if f(−x) = −f(x) (symmetric about the origin).

Example

Describe g(x) = −2|x + 1| + 4.

Reflect over the x-axis and stretch by 2

Left 1, up 4

Answer: Vertex moves from (0, 0) to (−1, 4)

Example

(2, 5) is on f. Where is it on g(x) = f(x + 3) − 1?

Left 3, down 1

Answer: (−1, 4)

Common mistakes

  • Shifting right for (x + 3). Inside the function, the shift is the opposite way: left 3.
  • Putting the vertical shift inside the parentheses.
  • Mixing up −f(x) (over the x-axis) and f(−x) (over the y-axis).
  • Thinking every function is either even or odd. Many are neither.

faq.q: How do you shift a graph to the right?
faq.a: Replace x with (x − h). For example, f(x − 4) is the graph of f moved 4 units right.

faq.q: What does a negative sign in front of a function do?
faq.a: −f(x) reflects the graph over the x-axis. A negative inside, f(−x), reflects it over the y-axis.

faq.q: What is the difference between a vertical stretch and a horizontal stretch?
faq.a: a·f(x) multiplies the y-values (vertical). f(bx) divides the x-values by b (horizontal).

faq.q: How can you tell if a function is even or odd?
faq.a: Find f(−x). If it equals f(x), the function is even. If it equals −f(x), the function is odd.

sets.title: Even and odd functions, domain and range

items.q: What is the range of g(x) = 2|x + 5| − 4?
items.e: The vertex is (−5, −4) and the graph opens up. y ≥ −4.

items.q: Is f(x) = 5x even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) = −f(x), so the graph is symmetric about the origin. Odd.

items.q: What is the range of g(x) = |x + 4| + 3?
items.e: The vertex is (−4, 3) and the graph opens up. y ≥ 3.

items.q: What is the domain of g(x) = √(x − 6) − 2?
items.e: The expression under the root must be ≥ 0: x − 6 ≥ 0. x ≥ 6.

items.q: Is f(x) = x² + x even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) equals neither f(x) nor −f(x). Neither.

items.q: Is f(x) = |x| + 5 even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) = f(x), so the graph is symmetric about the y-axis. Even.

items.q: Is f(x) = (x − 1)² even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) equals neither f(x) nor −f(x). Neither.

items.q: What is the domain of g(x) = √(x + 2) − 5?
items.e: The expression under the root must be ≥ 0: x + 2 ≥ 0. x ≥ −2.

items.q: Is f(x) = −2x⁶ + x² − 4 even, odd, or neither?

items.q: Is f(x) = x⁵ − x even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) = −f(x), so the graph is symmetric about the origin. Odd.

items.q: Is f(x) = x³ + 2x even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) = −f(x), so the graph is symmetric about the origin. Odd.

items.q: Is f(x) = 7 even, odd, or neither?
items.e: f(−x) = f(x), so the graph is symmetric about the y-axis. Even.

items.q: What is the range of g(x) = −|x − 4| + 6?
items.e: The vertex is (4, 6) and the graph opens down. y ≤ 6.

items.q: What is the domain of g(x) = √(x − 4)?
items.e: The expression under the root must be ≥ 0: x − 4 ≥ 0. x ≥ 4.

items.q: Is f(x) = x⁴ − 3x² even, odd, or neither?
